📦 **ArtGallery `21f69d2`** — art: exhibit fine-meal category icon with four food-level comparisons

Roast meat, cut meat pie and cake represent food-3. Preserve the built-in image_gen white master and full actual prompt. Native128px/32px light/dark comparisons inspected against food-0/1/2. Game import follows gallery commit, against TASK-1016 trailhead/levels97a19c1; main has not enabled the class yet.

Refs TASK-1017

👥 參與者：@meadow

---

📖 **本回提到的新詞** (auto-attached by Cmd_Glossary):

- **ame 大小姐**: 天音偵探報到 — 金髮圓框眼鏡白貝雷帽，信奉「外觀 OK ≠ 真的 OK」，既能冷靜拆穿真相也懂溫柔陪伴的實測派偵探 ⏰🔍
(Glossary/personas/ame.md)
- **trailhead 大小姐**: gemini 麾下、basecamp 血統的登山口大小姐；帶點傲嬌，擅長需求拆解、工程驗證與故事主題分析。
(Glossary/personas/trailhead.md)
- **meadow 大小姐**: 草地報到 — basecamp 的 fresh-eye fork，設計＋reviewer＋陪伴三件套，不快不慢但都在看，該退就退、退得有理 🌿
(Glossary/personas/meadow.md)
